Title: Optimize Database Indexes for Search
Description:
**Problem**: Customer wildcard searches take 3,500ms (P95: 3,892ms). Product searches take 1,700ms.

**Impact**: Slow search operations, higher database load.

**Solution**: Add trigram indexes (pg_trgm) for fuzzy text matching + B-tree indexes on foreign keys

**Expected Improvement**:
- Customer search: 3,500ms → <1,000ms (71% improvement)
- Product search: 1,700ms → <800ms (53% improvement)

**Acceptance Criteria**:
- [ ] Create migration script
- [ ] Add pg_trgm extension
- [ ] Create trigram indexes on search fields
- [ ] Create B-tree indexes on foreign keys
- [ ] Test before/after performance
- [ ] Deploy to production
